reason: A named lab with the report for my batch behind the QR code is what I actually look for, and 200 mg elemental from bisglycinate with no oxide is a clear dose. At $24.99 with the money-back guarantee I would try one box.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And with no reviews yet on a new brand, I would check the lab report before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page did not match the batch number or the lab could not be verified, I would not buy.
